column1: # CIPHER.tsv  sign-by-sign transcription, HHStA Frankreich Dipl.Korr. 17, Konv. Juli 1549, fol. 13r-14r (Renard to Charles V, 12 Jul 1549)

# Neutral labels only. Sxx = base sign in order of first appearance. Suffix: .1 mark above/right-above, .2 dot below, .3 underlined, .4 two dots above, .5 small dot or dash at left, .6 colon after, .7 small ring after; ? = doubtful reading.
# Combined suffixes are concatenated (S05.15 = mark above + dot at left). Shapes of the base signs: SIGNS.tsv (shape descriptions only, no values).
